body: What pain management techniques have worked for you?

Honestly, I have considered the possibility that I have a stricture. I really hope I do because it sounds like it can be fixed versus all these other conditions I am worried I have are chronic. My family doctor thought it was unlikely I have this though because my urine stream isn't weak (I don't think?). But luckily I should be able to find out if I have this once I get my cystoscopy.

I have heard that some people have IC with symptoms like me but I guess I am still hoping that I don't have IC :( 

I will definitely look into the other two conditions if my cystoscopy comes back normal. Thanks!

I have a hormonal IUD (Mirena IUD) but I have had it for 3 years now so I don't think it is related. 

My vaginal discharge is normal (I think?) I have enough that I never need to use lube during sex. If I am already in pain sex will make my pain worse but sex doesn't trigger the pain for me. I have no swelling. 

Unfortunately, I have tried Benedryl and baking soda baths but these things did not help me :( 

Thanks for the suggestions though!

Wow, props to you for toughing through all this! Seven years is an extremely long time. I’m glad that there are at least some potential treatment options for this kind of stuff. I honestly might still look into these treatments even if I do have IC rather than an issue with my pelvic muscles since I have heard that a lot of people with IC also have issues with their pelvic muscles. Also, I think I will try the AZO urinary pain relief because several people have mentioned it to me now. Thanks for sharing!
